reason: Settled security control for Wave 2b (#328/#356): frozen Go stripped signSMIME and shipped unsigned mail on missing infra (pool/minio nil) or unconfigured signing state. Rust enforces fail-closed signSMIME so missing S3 store, key, matching certificate, attachment part, signature, or S3 write prevents creation enqueue/commit, and signing/reading keys always bind to the authenticated actor ($actor), never the delegated mailbox owner.
